description: Managers with a blank death_country are excluded before counting and computing shares.

c.request: For managers in `manager_award` who match a `player` record on `player_id`, count each manager's awards by their `death_country` (NULL death countries drop out), and show what share of all the awards for managers with that same death country each one accounts for. Give manager id, death country, award count and share, top 10 by share (highest first, missing last), unrounded. Managers with a blank death_country are excluded before counting and computing shares.
c.sql: WITH mgr_awards AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM mgr_awards ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

b.request: Managers with a blank (empty-string or whitespace-only) death_country are excluded before counting, so each manager's awards are counted per death_country among matched player records, and each manager's share is their award count divided by the total awards for managers sharing that death_country, returning manager player_id, death_country, award count, and share, ordered by share descending with NULLs last, top 10, unrounded
b.sql: WITH award_counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country, ' ' || char(9) || char(10) || char(13)) <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count, CAST(award_count AS REAL) / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM award_counts ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

a.request: For each manager in `manager_award` who matches a `player` record on `player_id`, count their award rows by manager and the player's `death_country`. Managers with a NULL death country drop out. Also leave out managers whose death country is an empty string, so blank death countries form no group at all. Then show each manager's award count as a share of the total awards for all managers with the same death country. List manager id, death country, award count and share, sorted by share from highest to lowest (missing last). Show the top 10, unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT ma.player_id AS manager_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count, 1.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.death_country) AS share FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

d.request: For managers in `manager_award` who match a `player` record on `player_id`, count each manager's awards by their `death_country` (excluding NULL and blank values, which are dropped before counting), and show what share of all awards for managers with that same death country each one accounts for. Give manager id, death country, award count, and share, returning the top 10 by share (highest first, missing last), unrounded.
d.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country) SELECT player_id, death_country, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER (PARTITION BY death_country) AS share FROM counts ORDER BY share DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
